selectedOpportunitySelector.automaticWinnerParityScope: required when no ActivityLock; ActivityLock path is an explicit downstream override within Intent scope

intentInputReconstructionWitnessPolicy.rangeDerivedDataPolicy: recompute role feasibility and register stress from verified performer projections after ordinal-to-runtime-ID join; cached feasibility is not authority

selectedOpportunitySelector.specPreservingClosure: a verified canonical preimage of intentInputDigest supplies the assigned-track context already committed by the Intent input; it is not a new semantic authority or a separate Activity digest input

ACCENT_BLOCK.blockAttackSet: exact selected cue attack onset only
ACCENT_BLOCK.blockRange: selected Source Lead atom range clipped by one primary pulse, chord/source-atom boundary, phrase end, and N.C.
ACCENT_BLOCK.eligibleCueAttacks: production lyric emphasis or already-activated cadence/chord-fit cue; ordinary attack and bare chord change excluded
ACCENT_BLOCK.multiBlockSelection: greedy canonical cue order up to preset maxBlocks, spacing cap, and attack-ratio cap

ACTIVE_UNISON.attackSet: all Source Lead attack ordinals whose onset lies in [start,end)
ACTIVE_UNISON.candidateEndBoundaries: canonical Source Lead atom ends after start, before phrase end, positive Lead rest, explicit N.C. start, or occurrence boundary
ACTIVE_UNISON.exactTie: latest canonical end then attack-ordinal tuple
ACTIVE_UNISON.selection: latest boundary satisfying at least one Lead attack, preset coverage cap, and harmony attack-ratio cap

SUSTAINED_PAD.selection: longest legal common-tone sustain from selected cue under cap and vertical policy

TWO_PART_PARALLEL.selection: maximal legal contiguous response from selected cue under configured coverage and attack caps

cadencePolicyDerivation.activationAuthority: none; derived CadencePolicy never creates rest-to-active activity in rc.6
cadencePolicyDerivation.closed: phraseEnd == sectionEnd AND (sectionType=ending OR sectionVariant=final OR sectionType in chorus,tag)
cadencePolicyDerivation.invalid: phraseEnd > sectionEnd OR sectionEnd unavailable => PHRASE_COVERAGE_INVALID

canonicalTieBreakPolicy.note: different musical realizations must be separated by explicit score, not a universal sparsity tie-break

value.costUnitDefinition: 1 CostUnit = 1/1000 relative cost point; lower wins

leadAttackRatePerQuarterBandsBp.reason: 4/4 eighth-note and 6/8 eighth-note phrases normalize to the same attack rate

unison.hardPitchCheck: actual absolute unison pitch inside hardRange

leadDerivedRolePolicy.unisonToSplit: role determined from post-split independent mandatory anchors

value.meterStylePolicy: meterFamily defines primary pulse for alignment; attack-density scoring uses exact quarter-note duration; no meter-only texture, sustain, or attack bonus

standard.adjudication: passing/neighbor retained only under strict nctPathCost < plainChordTonePathCost; no rate target; audit blanket-disable patch not adopted

pathComparison.endpointCosts: exclude from both paths or include once in both; implementation must choose exclude-from-both in rc3
pathComparison.plainPathHoldVsReattack: choose lower hard-legal plain realization using the same endpoints and window

nctSelectionCost.selectionRule: select only if nctPathCost < plainChordTonePathCost; exact tie chooses plain chord tone

value.noChordTargetScale: scale P,D2,D3,A by duration-weighted chordCoverageBp/10000 using round-half-up

durationAwareLineCost.phraseBoundaryLeap: downstream boundary cost and report metric

identityContextCost.policy: third is strongly valuable only when it supplies chord quality not already present

twoHarmonyJointRules.plannedSuspensionSecondException: allowed with cost 1000 and mandatory deadline resolution
twoHarmonyJointRules.samePitchClassAtDifferentOctave: ineligible for independent harmony; octave behavior must be lead-derived

verticalIntervalToLead.policy: new independent attack ineligible; held independent harmony may use transient convergence policy

realizedActivityFingerprint.reason: avoid Intent→Activity stage cycle; calibrate downstream after A/B

canonicalRoleTiePolicy.policy: sectionType is not a placement-role cue

candidateOrdering: role absent from Lead before duplicate
same tone as previous obligation before change
primaryHarmonyRoleObligationPolicy.candidateSet: ParsedChord tones with at least one hard-range-legal pitch for primary track and placement role
primaryHarmonyRoleObligationPolicy.leadCoveredRoleDerivation: exact current Source Lead chord-tone role; empty for Lead NCT/unclassified tone

secondTrackRoleContributionPolicy.candidateSet: identity-critical ParsedChord tones absent from Lead role plus primary obligation role, with hard-range-legal extra-track pitch

splitPolicy.sameReasonTieBreak: canonical MusicalPosition ascending; no musical preference implied

ACCENT_BLOCK.secondTrackSelectionRule: cue-qualified short block optional alternative; never D3 underfill

SUSTAINED_PAD.canonicalResponseRule: longest legal sustain from selected cue, bounded by automatic cap and chord/common-tone validity; arbitrary shorter siblings are not enumerated

holdCurrentVowel.eligibility: entry aligns with pitched Lead lyric onset AND lead duration>=1 pulse or lyric extend

SUSTAINED_PAD.secondTrackSelectionRule: independent cue-qualified delayed overlap; never D3 underfill

sustainedPitchVerticalPolicy.otherIntervals: use verticalIntervalToLead with duration-weighted average cost once per sustain span

transientUnisonOrWholeStep.newAttackAtUnisonOrWholeStep: ineligible unless lead-derived or planned NCT

boundedWindowMinimumRun.rule: at least one condition must be met; otherwise classify as ACCENT_BLOCK or ineligible

TWO_PART_PARALLEL.canonicalResponseRule: for a selected cue, generate one maximal legal response within configured coverage cap; do not enumerate arbitrary shorter siblings

fullPhraseAutomatic.reason: attack-for-attack full phrase is 10000bp and exceeds every authoritative preset attack cap

activeUnisonCanonicalResponse.rule: maximal legal contiguous response beginning at selected cue onset; exact end/attack set from activityResponseConstructors.ACTIVE_UNISON

UNISON_TO_SPLIT.secondTrackSelectionRule: cue-qualified short-window optional alternative; never D3 underfill
